segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the renewal and the small expansion you mentioned for the calibration team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 18 seats today, and we want to add 7 more for the second shift before April 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So 25 total named users, same calibration workflow module, same reporting package. The current term ends May 31, so we can either coterm the 7 seats through May or just start the new 12-month term a little early.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let’s keep it clean and start the new term June 1. We can wait on access until then, that’s fine.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay. On the pricing sheet, 25 seats on an annual term comes to $31,250, and support stays included. The implementation services line is zero since you’re already live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I expected. Can the invoice split the software and the on-site gauge audit as separate lines?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. The audit is two days at $1,800 per day, so $3,600. I’ll show that as a separate services line with the June 18 target date.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 30, same billing contact, same ship-to location for the audit. I’ll send the order form over this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If I get it by 3, I can route it for signature today.
